title: Left drive torque mismatch
description: Left drive reports torque mismatch during motion.
likely_causes: Loose motor connector; driver overheated; encoder slip.
recovery_steps: 1) Stop AMR safely 2) Power cycle 60s 3) Inspect motor/driver connectors 4) Check encoder seating 5) Retry slow move test.
verification: Run 2m low-speed path; verify no alarms.
notes: If repeats, collect driver LED pattern.

title: Motor overcurrent trip
description: Drive current exceeded limit; controller cut output.
likely_causes: Wheel obstruction; seized bearing; cable short; aggressive accel settings.
recovery_steps: 1) E-Stop then clear 2) Inspect wheel path for obstruction 3) Check wheel rotation by hand 4) Power cycle 5) Retry with reduced speed.
notes: If physical resistance found, remove from service.

title: Localization confidence low
description: AMR localization confidence dropped below threshold.
likely_causes: Dirty lidar cover; reflective surfaces; map mismatch.
recovery_steps: 1) Clean lidar window 2) Move to known landmark 3) Run relocalize routine 4) Retry mission.

title: Path planning blocked
description: Planner cannot find valid path to goal.
likely_causes: Aisle blocked; forbidden zone too large; map stale.
recovery_steps: 1) Check aisle blockage 2) Move AMR to open area 3) Retry with alternate waypoint 4) Confirm map zones.
notes: If zone config issue, notify controls.

title: Charging handshake failed
likely_causes: Dirty charge contacts; charger offline; comm cable issue.
recovery_steps: 1) Clean charge contacts 2) Re-seat at dock 3) Reboot dock if allowed 4) Retry.
notes: If dock down, redirect to spare dock.
